What this isŠta je ovo

Not a restaurant. An evening that belongs to you.Ovo nije restoran. Ovo je veče koje pripada vama.

Nikola Alić

Chef and hostKuvar i domaćin

He learned the craft as a student, from the best in the profession. He went on to work as a chef in Belgrade’s luxury restaurants, side by side with colleagues from Michelin-starred kitchens, and spent several years cooking on private yachts along the Mediterranean. Mediterranean cuisine is closest to his heart, and his plates also carry the flavours of Asia and Europe.Zanat je učio još kao student, od najboljih u struci. Kasnije je radio kao šef u luksuznim beogradskim restoranima, rame uz rame sa kolegama iz restorana sa Michelinovim zvezdicama, a nekoliko godina proveo je na privatnim jahtama duž Mediterana. Mediteranska kuhinja mu je najbliža, a na tanjir rado donosi i ukuse Azije i Evrope.

François Louyot

Ingredients and wineNamirnice i vino

For more than ten years François has supplied the most important restaurants in Serbia. Before that he worked for the Michelin Guide and spoke with more than a hundred starred chefs. At the table he tells you where everything came from, in his own mix of English and French.Više od deset godina snabdeva najvažnije restorane u Srbiji. Pre toga je radio za Michelinov vodič i razgovarao sa više od sto šefova sa zvezdicom. Za stolom priča odakle je šta stiglo, na svojoj mešavini engleskog i francuskog.

The houseKuća

Velike Pčelice, Šumadija

A private house in Velike Pčelice, south of Kragujevac. A salon that watches the sun go down, and a long wooden table laid for your party alone.Privatna kuća u Velikim Pčelicama, južno od Kragujevca. Salon iz kojeg se gleda zalazak sunca i dugačak drveni sto, postavljen samo za vaše društvo.
